description: Scan in.mp4's video bitstream at the packet level (no decoding) and write every NAL unit's details — parameter sets, slice headers, SEI — to bitstream_trace.json. An improved, machine-readable version of FFmpeg's trace_headers bitstream filter.
ffmpeg_cmd: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c copy -bsf:v trace_headers -f null - 2> trace.txt  # text only; the graph writes structured JSON instead
